description: This file implements a WebSocket-based gateway communication mechanism, including protocols, actors, and related data structures for managing WebSocket sessions, authentication, reconnection logic, and message handling within the OpenClawKit project.

classes.name: WebSocketTasking
classes.description: Protocol defining WebSocket task behaviors such as resume, cancel, send, and receive, allowing abstraction over URLSessionWebSocketTask.

classes.name: WebSocketSessioning
classes.description: Protocol for creating WebSocket tasks from a session, enabling dependency injection for testing.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: Wrapper around any WebSocketTasking instance, providing thread-safe task control methods.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: Wrapper around a WebSocketSessioning instance for dependency injection.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scopes, capabilities, commands, permissions, client info.

classes.name: GatewayAuthSource
classes.description: Enumeration of possible authentication token sources used during connection.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: Actor responsible for managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, handling messaging, reconnection, authentication, and keepalive logic in a concurrent environment.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the gateway, including handshake and authentication.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the WebSocket connection and cancels associated tasks.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request over the WebSocket, waits for a response, and returns the payload data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to the WebSocket server.
